title: Black Canyon Ultras presented by HOKA — 2027 event page
claims: The 2027 Black Canyon Ultras are scheduled for 13-14 February 2027, with the 100K on Saturday 13 February and the 50K on Sunday 14 February, both starting at Mayer High School in Spring Valley, Arizona.

The event offers two distances, 100K and 50K, both point to point on the Black Canyon National Recreation Trail; the 100K finishes at Emery Henderson Trailhead near New River and the 50K finishes at Deep Canyon Ranch.
The 100K course is listed at 62.2 miles with a 20-hour limit, +5,219 ft and -7,337 ft of elevation, a maximum elevation of 4,199 ft and a minimum of 1,737 ft.
The 50K course is listed at 32.2 miles with an 11-hour limit, +2,004 ft and -4,005 ft, a maximum elevation of 4,199 ft and a minimum of 1,986 ft.

The 100K starts in three waves at 07:00, 07:30 and 08:00 MST; the 50K Event Timeline and Cut-off Times table on the 2026-11-24 page also list three waves, 07:00, 07:30 and 08:00 (a 2026-11-20 snapshot of the cut-off table listed only two waves).

The 100K aid-station table lists Antelope Mesa at mile 7.7, Hidden Treasure at 12.9, Bumble Bee Ranch at 19.4, Gloriana Mine at 24.0, Deep Canyon Ranch at 31.9, Black Canyon City Trailhead at 37.2, Cottonwood Gulch at 46.4, Table Mesa at 51.1, Doe Spring at 58.7 and Emery Henderson/Finish at 62.3, with crew and drop bags at Bumble Bee Ranch, Deep Canyon Ranch, Table Mesa and the finish; the Cottonwood row says a 9.0-mile segment, while 46.4 minus 37.2 is 9.2 miles, so the published segment and cumulative mile do not reconcile.
The 100K aid-station text says there are nine aid stations spaced 4.5 to 9 miles apart, while its own table lists ten rows including the finish.

The 50K aid-station text says there are six aid stations and four crew access points with four drop bags, while its own table lists five aid stations, crew access only at Bumble Bee Ranch and Deep Canyon Ranch, and a drop bag only at Deep Canyon Ranch.

The 100K cut-off table gives, for the 07:00 wave: Antelope Mesa 09:15, Hidden Treasure 10:45, Bumble Bee 12:45, Gloriana 14:30, Deep Canyon 17:00, Black Canyon City 19:00, Cottonwood 22:00, Table Mesa 23:30, Doe Springs 02:00 and finish 03:00; the 07:30 and 08:00 waves move every cut-off 30 and 60 minutes later.

The 50K cut-off table gives, for the 07:00 wave: Antelope Mesa 09:45, Hidden Treasure 11:15, Bumble Bee 13:15, Gloriana 15:00 and the Deep Canyon finish at 18:00; the 07:30 wave moves each by 30 minutes to an 18:30 finish, and the 08:00 wave moves each by 60 minutes to a 19:00 finish.
Pacers are allowed only in the 100K, may join from Deep Canyon Ranch at mile 31.9, and may switch at Table Mesa, which the same page lists both as mile 50.9 and mile 51.1.
The 100K is a Western States 100 qualifier requiring completion under 17 hours; the 20-hour race limit is separate from that 17-hour WSER qualifying standard.

The 100K is a 2027 Golden Ticket race with three automatic men's and three automatic women's places; the page's own first-screen copy is stale and still refers to the 2026 race and 2026 Western States, so the 2027 rule is taken from the WSER Golden Ticket page.
Entry limits are 1,200 runners for each distance; 2027 pricing runs from $350 to $380 for the 100K and $250 to $280 for the 50K, and registration closes on 6 February 2027.

The course begins with three miles of paved and dirt roads from Spring Valley, joins the Black Canyon Trail single track via Antelope Creek Road, alternates single track and jeep road, includes a short out-and-back at the Black Canyon City aid station, has several creek crossings with the largest at mile 34, and puts most of the climbing and technical descending in the final miles.
The route diverts from the Black Canyon Trail at three checkpoints: Bumble Bee Ranch, Deep Canyon Ranch, reconnecting on Kay Mine Road, and the Black Canyon City out-and-back.
The Black Canyon National Recreation Trail is about 80 miles long, was established by the Department of the Interior in 1919 as a livestock driveway, and the race uses a 55-mile section of it.

The 2027 page's 100K Course Map tab embeds Strava route 3200513436733241212 and links a CalTopo map UVSJ5; its 50K tab embeds Strava route 3211373289185870782 and links a CalTopo map HPSHM2N; no .gpx or .kml download link is present on the page.

The embedded 100K Strava route card states 62.7 miles and +5,254 ft, while the 50K card states 32.2 miles and +1,994 ft; these sit beside Key Stats of 62.2 miles / +5,219 ft / -7,337 ft for the 100K and 32.2 miles / +2,004 ft / -4,005 ft for the 50K, so the first-party figures do not match.
Crew access is allowed at Bumble Bee Ranch, Deep Canyon Ranch and Table Mesa; crew access to the 100K finish at Emery Henderson is by shuttle only from the Anthem Outlets.

The 2027 Saturday shuttle table lists Wave 1 leaving Anthem at 05:45 and arriving at Mayer at 06:30, Wave 2 leaving at 06:20 and arriving at 07:05, and Wave 3 leaving at 06:45 and arriving at 07:30; runners who miss their wave bus must wait for the next one and start in the corresponding wave.

Bib pickup is at Aravaipa HQ on Thursday 11 February 12:00–17:00, at Chilleen's on 17 on Friday 12 February 10:00–18:00, and for the 50K at Deep Canyon Ranch on Saturday 13 February 12:00–18:00; no race-day pickup is available.
The official medical provider is MedStar Solutions; runners are told to call 480-269-4126 instead of 911, and to give bib number, callback number, location and mile, problem and description.
The race is cupless: aid stations provide no paper cups for cold drinks, runners must carry a bottle, cup or hydration system, and hot cups are available only for coffee, broth and soup.
The 2027 page gives sunset at 18:06 and recommends lights in the Bumble Bee drop bag for 18–20-hour finishers, Deep Canyon for 14–18 hours and Table Mesa for 11–14 hours.

The official course-record table gives 100K men 7:20:00 by Hans Troyer in 2026, 100K women 7:57:05 by Jennifer Lichter in 2026, 50K men 3:16:29 by Seth Ruhling in 2026 and 50K women 3:45:09 by Allison Baca in 2025.

The page lists three free training runs: Big Bug Trailhead to Bumblebee on 29 November 2026 (18 miles), Bumblebee to Black Canyon City on 20 December 2026 (20 miles) and Black Canyon City to Emery on 24 January 2027 (25 miles).

Runners must close every cattle gate behind them, cross county roads carefully because vehicles are not required to stop, and expect possible gunfire from shooting ranges near Hidden Treasure, Bumble Bee Ranch and Table Mesa.
